verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own docs say Server Pro adds a management API alongside its web console, so a first-party API exists. Nothing shows that it matches what the UI can do. The evidence is a single thin mention, the API is Pro-only, and its scope beyond console management is undocumented. Missing for 10: documented API reference and endpoint coverage, evidence of parity with web-console and client UI actions (sessions, file transfer, settings), availability in the OSS server, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Server Pro adds a web console, device groups, a shared address book, per-user and device-group access control, audit logs, and a management API.
